title: Saricheyunu – Paul Dhinakaran Telugu Christian Lyrics

ninnu saricheyunu sthiraparachunu balaparachi poornuni cheyun

credits.Vocals: Dr. Paul Dhinakaran, Samuel Dhinakaran, Stella Ramola

intro: Saricheyunu is the latest Telugu Christian song translated from its tamil song, Seerpaduthuvaar released on Jan 01, 2022 written & tuned by Pastor John Jebaraj. This song was translated & sung by Dr. Paul Dhinakaran, Samuel Dhinakaran, Stella Ramola and music composed by Derrick Paul. This song video was released on December 11, 2022 through Jesus Call Telugu YouTube channel.
